title: Hard-Gate Candidacy in a Deployed Validator Suite
abstract: arXiv:2609.39037v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Before a validator can be promoted to a hard gate on a deployment pipeline, it has to be shown that its firing separates outputs that reach users in working order from those that do not. We run that screen on 13 validators in a deployed generative agent, against 550 runtime and 350 static builds labelled by downstream outcome, and report each check's marginal separation $J=\mathrm{TPR}-\mathrm{FPR}$ with Newcombe intervals and Fisher exact tests. Two checks survive correction for multiple comparisons, two more are nominal only, and the remaining nine are not distinguishable from zero, three of them because they never fired on any sampled build. Execution itself is not random with respect to the property being gated, and this replicates: across four runs covering 1,867 builds and ten distinct runtime checks, probes were skipped on 144 of 895 broken builds and 1 of 972 acceptable builds (per-run rates 15.6% to 16.6% against at most 0.3%)

translated_title: 已部署验证器套件中的硬门禁候选资格评估
translated_abstract: 在验证器被提升为部署流水线上的硬门禁之前，必须证明其触发能够将正常到达用户的输出与未能正常到达用户的输出区分开来。我们在一个已部署的生成式智能体上，针对550个运行时构建和350个静态构建（均按下游结果标注）对13个验证器进行了这项筛选，并使用Newcombe置信区间和Fisher精确检验报告每个检查项的边际区分度 $J=\mathrm{TPR}-\mathrm{FPR}$。两个检查项在多重比较校正后仍然显著，另外两个仅在名义上显著，其余九个与零无法区分，其中三个是因为它们在任何抽样构建上都从未触发过。执行过程本身相对于被门禁控制的属性并非随机，且这一现象具有可重复性：在覆盖1,867个构建和十种不同运行时检查的四次运行中，探针在895个损坏构建中的144个上被跳过，而在972个合格构建中仅有1个被跳过（各次运行中跳过率为15.6%至16.6%，相比之下合格构建至多0.3%）。
tldr: 本研究对部署流水线上13个验证器的硬门禁资格进行筛选评估，发现仅2个检查项经多重比较校正后仍具显著区分度，且运行时探针在损坏构建上被跳过的比例（约16%）远高于合格构建（至多0.3%），表明执行行为本身与被门禁的属性并非相互独立。
en_tdlr: Screening 13 validators for hard-gate candidacy in a deployed generative agent shows only two checks remain significant after multiple-comparison correction, and runtime probes were skipped on about 16% of broken builds versus at most 0.3% of acceptable builds, indicating execution itself is not random with respect to the gated property.
